children: The total oil production of the Sultanate of Oman increased by 11.3 percent by the end of July 2026, reaching 233.80 million barrels, compared to 210.12 million barrels during the corresponding period in 2025, according to preliminary data issued by the National Centre for Statistics and Information (NCSI).
The average oil price also rose by 15.7 percent, reaching $83.9 per barrel by the end of July 2026, compared to $72.5 during the same period in 2025.

On the production front, the average daily oil production recorded a growth of 11.3 percent, reaching 1.10 million barrels per day by the end of July 2026, compared to 991,100 barrels per day during the corresponding period in 2025.
In terms of exports, Oman oil exports increased by 1.8 percent, amounting to 181.93 million barrels by the end of July 2026, compared to 178.74 million barrels during the same period in 2025.

title: ZAWYA: Oil production in Oman rises by 11.3% to 233.80mln barrels by end of July 2026
